name: Warp OG social card — orbiting illustration collage on a dark blueprint grid by warp.dev
description: A 1200×630 social card that treats itself like a dark design board: a near-black field with faint hairline gridlines, plus-mark intersections and dashed centre guides, over which twelve rounded tiles are scattered in a loose elliptical orbit around a single white logo glyph. Each tile holds a different vintage night-sky illustration — aurora curtains, comets, rain, sepia clouds — in muted teal, indigo, charcoal and beige, so the collage reads as a deck of slides pinned to a canvas. There is no headline at all; hierarchy comes entirely from the bright central mark against the dim grid, with tile size and hue variation supplying the rhythm.
